The year '''3643 before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (BBY)''' was a period of time during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Better known during that time as '''year 10 after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] (ATC)''', the events of the year featured renewed conflict between agents of the two superpowers and heightened tensions throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Various events, such as the [[Desolator crisis]], the [[SpecForce Incident|defection]] of the Republic's [[Havoc Squad]], an [[Assault on the Esseles|attack]] on the Republic cruiser [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']], and many other conflicts throughout the galaxy continued to add to the political anxieties and concern of the last decade.

==Events==
*[[Jet Nebula]] discovers the ''[[Cinzia]]'', initiating the Sebaddon affair and [[Fastbreeder|Hex droid]] crisis. {{Circa}}<ref name="TOR:FA">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>
*The native [[Flesh Raider]]s of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], under the influence of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]], [[Flesh Raider uprising|begin attacking]] the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Pilgrims]] in greater numbers and frequency.
*The [[Hero of Tython|new apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] [[Battle of the Forge|successfully defeats]] Morr with the help of the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] and end the threat of his Flesh Raider army.<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Weapon of the Jedi|Tython}}</ref>
*Din's apprentice, now a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], is sent with T7 to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to investigate a dark presence the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] senses there.<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi" /> There, the duo team up with [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] and [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] to [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|recover]] the plans for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> and [[Skirmish in Docking Bay 84|rescue]] Doctor [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]], the project's lead [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], from the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate.<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Kidnapped|Coruscant}}</ref>
*[[Senate Day]]<ref name="Senatorial">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Senatorial Celebration|Coruscant}}</ref><ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Senatorial Celebration|Coruscant}}</ref>
*The Imperial warship ''[[Emperor's Glory]]'', under the command of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]], [[Assault on the Esseles|attacks]] the Republic cruiser [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] with [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] aid in an attempt to capture Ambassador [[Vyn Asara]]. However, a team of Jedi and Republic operatives successfully push back the attack and disable the ''Glory''{{'s}} [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], allowing the ''Esseles'' to escape.<ref name="Esseles">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|''Esseles''}}</ref>

*Angral [[Devastation of Uphrades|attacks]] the planet [[Uphrades]] with the completed [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] weapon, devastating the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld's]] surface as a test of the superweapon's capabilities.<ref name="Uphrades">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Uphrades|Uphrades}}</ref>
